description: Space Invaders online free: move your cannon, shoot the descending aliens, and don't let them land. Three lives, endless waves, and a bonus UFO.
lede: The 1978 arcade classic, in your browser. Rows of pixel invaders march down from the top of the screen, stepping sideways and dropping lower with every move, and your little green cannon is the only thing between them and Earth. Shoot them all to clear the wave — but the next wave comes back faster, and a red UFO sometimes streaks across the top worth 100 points. You have three lives, so make every shot count.

p: Press Start defending and the invaders begin their march. Move your cannon with the arrow keys or by dragging on the board, and press Space — or tap the FIRE button — to shoot. Your bullets fly up and destroy one invader each. The invaders step sideways together, drop a row lower whenever they reach an edge, and shoot back at you.

You have three lives. An alien bullet that hits your cannon costs one life, and if any invader reaches the green ground line, the game is over at once. Clear every invader to finish the wave: you earn a 100-point bonus and a faster wave takes its place.

Not every invader is worth the same. The little squid at the top is worth the most, the crabs in the middle are worth 20, and the big octopuses at the bottom are worth 10. The red UFO that sometimes crosses the top of the screen is worth 100 points — shoot it whenever you see it.

sections.h: The game that started a craze
p: Space Invaders was released in Japan by Taito in 1978, designed by Tomohiro Nishikado. It was one of the first shooting games with a fixed screen of enemies that moved as a group, and it became a phenomenon: arcades filled with its cabinets, and the story goes that it caused a shortage of 100-yen coins in Japan as players fed them into the machines.

Nishikado built the game on hardware that could barely move that many sprites, and the famous speeding-up was an accident: as you shoot invaders, the processor has fewer sprites to draw, so the survivors move faster. The game keeps that behaviour here — the last few invaders of a wave are the quickest, and the most dangerous.

ol: Shoot the bottom rows first. The invaders at the bottom are the ones closest to landing, and clearing a column opens a lane to the rows above.
Stay under a gap, not under a column. Alien bullets come from the lowest invader in each column, so the safest place is under a column you have already cleared.
Use the edges. The invaders drop a row when they reach an edge, so let them march — every edge turn brings them lower, and your shots get easier as the formation narrows.
Watch for the UFO. It crosses the top quickly and is worth 100 points, more than three squids — but never chase it so far that you walk into an alien bullet.
One bullet at a time, aimed. You can only have three of your bullets on screen, so wild firing wastes shots. Wait until an invader is in your line, then fire.
On a phone, drag with one thumb to steer and tap FIRE with the other. The cannon follows your finger, so you can keep moving while you shoot.

p: For another fast, one-more-go classic, smash the bricks in [[breakout]] or whack the moles in [[whack-a-mole]]. If you would rather fly than shoot, flap through the pipes in [[flappy-bird]]. You can find every fast, one-more-go game in [[cat:arcade|arcade games]].

faq: How do I move and shoot?
Move with the Left and Right arrow keys or A and D, or drag your finger across the board. Press Space — or tap the yellow FIRE button — to shoot.
How many lives do I get?
Three. An alien bullet that hits your cannon costs one life, and the cannon comes back with a short moment of protection so you cannot be hit twice at once.
What happens if the invaders reach the bottom?
The game ends at once, even if you still have lives. The green line at the bottom is the last line of defence.
Why do the invaders speed up?
They always did. As you destroy invaders there are fewer of them to move, so the survivors step faster — and each new wave starts faster than the last.
What is the red UFO worth?
100 points. It crosses the top of the screen every so often, moving fast. Shoot it whenever you get a clear line.
